title: AI Sales Automation
shortDescription: An automated qualification and outreach engine that scores inbound leads, enriches them and routes each to the right owner within minutes.
fullDescription: A revenue team was drowning in inbound volume of wildly uneven quality. We built an engine that ingests every lead from every source, enriches it against public and internal data, scores it against a rubric agreed with the sales leadership, and either routes it to an owner with a briefing or places it into a nurture sequence. Reps stopped triaging and started selling.

features.title: Unified lead ingestion
features.description: Forms, ads, chat, email and partner feeds normalised into a single schema with deduplication on arrival.

features.title: Automatic enrichment
features.description: Company size, sector and technology signals appended before a human ever opens the record.

features.title: Rubric-based scoring
features.description: Leads scored against explicit, versioned criteria so the reasoning behind a score is always inspectable.

features.title: Ownership routing
features.description: Territory, capacity and specialism rules assign each lead to the right rep with a written briefing.

features.title: Adaptive nurture
features.description: Below-threshold leads enter a sequence that re-scores them as new signals arrive.

features.title: Pipeline reporting
features.description: Source quality, conversion by score band and response-time tracking in one view.

challenge.summary: Lead response time averaged over a day because every enquiry was triaged by hand, and no one could tell which acquisition channels were actually producing revenue.

points.title: Six disconnected channels
points.description: Leads arrived through six disconnected channels with no shared format or deduplication.

points.title: First response over 24 hours
points.description: Manual triage meant the average first response took more than 24 hours.

points.title: Scoring varied by person
points.description: Scoring was intuition-based and varied by whoever happened to pick up the record.

points.title: Channel spend without attribution
points.description: Channel spend decisions were made without reliable attribution.

solution.summary: We separated the deterministic work from the judgement work: rules handle routing and thresholds, models handle interpretation of unstructured text.

points.title: One validated lead schema
points.description: Built a single ingestion layer normalising every source into one validated schema.

points.title: AI only where it adds value
points.description: Used models only for the genuinely fuzzy parts — reading free-text enquiries and summarising company context.

points.title: Scoring rules without deploys
points.description: Encoded the scoring rubric as versioned configuration so sales leadership can change weightings without a deploy.

points.title: A human review queue
points.description: Added a review queue for borderline scores rather than forcing the system to guess.

points.title: Funnel measured end to end
points.description: Instrumented the full funnel so channel performance is measured against closed revenue, not lead count.

objectives: Unify lead capture from all six channels into one clean record
Bring first response time down from days to minutes
Score every lead against a rubric sales leadership can change
Never guess on borderline leads — route them to a human review queue
Attribute channel performance to closed revenue
clientOverview: A sales organisation collecting leads through six separate channels with no shared format and no reliable scoring. Triage fell to whoever picked up the record first, first responses took more than a day, and the marketing budget was being steered by intuition rather than evidence.
conclusion: Inbound leads are now qualified, enriched and routed to the right owner within minutes of arrival. Scoring is consistent, explainable, and controlled by sales leadership through versioned configuration, borderline cases go to a human review queue instead of a guess, and channel spend is measured against closed revenue — not lead counts.
